newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower, rolling out of July noted.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower, rolling out of July noted.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower, led by nearby July, on rolling of long positions from the July to the new crop months, traders said.
"They were rolling out of the July," a trader said referring to the sharp drop in the July relative to other months.
The new crop months also ended under pressure on good crop weather in the U.S.
"Weather is not spectacular but it certainly is good enough for the crop," he said.
Rice closed one to 11-1/2 cents per cwt lower, with July down 11-1/2 at $11.37 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 200 contracts, above the 101 traded Friday.
